newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Lank Orix up 1.33 pct up good results.
newsitem.headline: Lank Orix up 1.33 pct up good results.

text.p: Shares of Lanka Orix Leasing rose 1.33 percent or two rupees to 152 on Wednesday on improved profit figures, brokers said.
"The market is reacting to nine-month results just released," said a broker who declined to be identified.

The company said earlier its net profit for nine months to December 31, 1996 rose 48.7 percent to 135.98 million rupees, compared to 91.45 million rupees in the same period of the previous financial year.
Lanka Orix Leasing is one of three big leasing firms listed in Colombo.
